orgs.name: FILO (Somos Filo) - Burger Fest, Gochiso, Foodies, Filo Summer Fest and other food festivals
orgs.members_estimate: 30+ burger businesses at Burger Fest Vol. 9 (Diario Correo, May 2026); ~124K Instagram followers (filo.com.pe, Nov 2026)
orgs.notes: Lima festival organiser (founder Nachi Benza) running Burger Fest, Gochiso (5th edition, 28 Mar 2026), Parriland, Pollito con Chifa and more, each with a roster of food vendors. No email published; the site's form is titled '¿Quieres ser parte de nuestros eventos?'.

orgs.name: Mercado 28

emails.reason: Published as a mailto link on the home page; mercado28.pe has Google MX records.

orgs.notes: Food hall ('first gastronomic market in Peru') that manages a roster of small food concepts; Gestion reported early 2026 on its 2025 results and expansion plans. Stall vendors rather than trucks, so a weaker fit.

orgs.name: FENTEP - Federación Nacional de Trabajadores Emolienteros y Afines del Perú
orgs.members_estimate: unknown; Congress says 20,000+ emoliente vendors still informal (Congreso, Jul 2026)
orgs.notes: National union of emoliente street-drink cart vendors (president Edgar Liberato Sáenz), named in the 2024-2026 emoliente bills and Ley 32570 debate. No website, social page or email found; poor fit for pre-ordering.

orgs.name: FENEGAP - Federación Nacional de Emolienteros Generadores de Autoempleo Productivo y Afines del Perú
orgs.notes: Second emoliente vendors' federation; its legal adviser is quoted in an undated Congress press note asking for municipal ordinances. No contact route found.

orgs.name: Lima Sabrosa (food truck park)
orgs.notes: Food truck court in Surquillo built around the Lima Sabrosa burger brand; reviews are undated and no current social page was found. Could be a single operator rather than a host of independent trucks.

orgs.name: Food Trucks Perú (collective)
orgs.members_estimate: 5 trucks (El Gringo, La Calé, Lima Sabrosa, Gohan and others) and about 3,000 visitors at Parque de la Pera (Peru Retail, 2015)
orgs.notes: Early group of Lima truck owners who ran joint events in San Isidro; nothing after 2015. Probably the same people who went on to form APEFOODT (the press also calls it 'AFTP').

orgs.name: FEDEVAL - Federación Departamental de Vendedores Ambulantes de Lima y Callao
orgs.notes: StreetNet affiliate for all street vendors (not only food) in Lima and Callao; the newest dated item found is from 2014. A general vendors' body, so a weak fit.
